title: PoP re-paired
description: An operator minted a new pairing string for a PoP relay, which refuses the credential paired under the old one (R74, docs/76). The pairing string itself is never in any event, and neither is an address or a credential. The `data` of a `fi.ioio.gawk.pop.repaired` CloudEvent.

pop.description: The PoP the operator acted on: the Pop resource's name.

displayName.description: The PoP's name as shown to people.
